title: Chapter 74: Group Photo
html:
Red has the longest wavelength in the visible spectrum. Set against black, it creates a stark optical contrast.

The house was dark as night, while the figures shone red as fresh blood. The image exerted an oppressive weight on anyone who saw it.

“Drawing is his favorite pastime. He doesn’t like going out and spends most of his time alone in his room.” Fan Yu’s aunt had entered without Chen Ge noticing, carrying two glasses of water. “All I want now is for him to grow up happy, like any other boy.”

She handed one glass to Chen Ge and placed the other beside Fan Yu. “Let’s go outside. Strangers make him uncomfortable.”

“Okay.” Chen Ge returned to the living room, holding the glass of water. The woman sat down across from him.

“Do you have any other questions?” The woman’s guard had risen again.

“I believe he suffered severe trauma when he was young. If he’s going to recover, we need to understand its source.” Chen Ge carefully voiced his thoughts. “You’re his only family, and you clearly care about him. Would you mind answering a few more questions?”

The woman nodded. A fine sheen of sweat covered her brow, perhaps from the heat.

“Earlier, you mentioned that Fan Yu’s parents went missing after going out in search of him, so where was Fan Yu ultimately found?”

“At Mu Yang High School. He was hiding in my brother’s office.”

“Mu Yang High School again? Everything seems to lead back there.”

“You have no idea…” The woman sighed. “Mu Yang High School was the worst school in Jiujiang. I never understood why it existed. Before it closed, the police were there every other day breaking up fights.”

“That serious?” Chen Ge listened closely. After all, getting the information from the woman was much more convenient than researching online.

“That’s not all.” The woman stood, her expression grave. “The school is famously haunted. Local elders say a crematorium once stood there. The city demolished it during redevelopment, but think about it—how peaceful could a school built on such ground possibly be? I begged my brother not to work there, but he wouldn’t listen.”

“Then why did your brother insist on going to teach at Mu Yang High School?”

“The salary was good, and his disciplinary record made other jobs hard to find. Who could have known it would be his last?”

“A record? Did he make some enemies? Could his disappearance be related to that?” Chen Ge latched onto the details in the woman’s conversation.

“No, nothing like that. My brother drank too much and behaved badly when he did. His previous school fired him, leaving a disciplinary mark on his record. Jiujiang has only so many schools, so finding another position was difficult.”

“Then, his disappearance doesn’t sound like it was caused by revenge.”

“It’s definitely not.”

The woman’s confidence made Chen Ge narrow his eyes. “How can you be so sure?”

After a moment’s hesitation, the woman took a photograph from a drawer and placed it on the table. “One classroom remained locked from the day the school opened. Staff and students were forbidden to enter, and only the headmaster knew why. When he died, the reason died with him. Legends still surround the room. Some say it was reserved for spirits from the crematorium; others claim construction workers suffered a tragedy there before the school was finished. Whatever the truth, it is a very dark place.”

“What does that have to do with your brother’s disappearance?” Chen Ge was confused.

“Take a look at this, and you will understand why.”

Chen Ge accepted the strange group photograph. A drunken man sat at its center, surrounded by several rows of students.

At first glance, it resembled an ordinary graduation photo—except every student had their back to the camera.

Worse, a closer look revealed that every one of them stood on tiptoe.

“Where did you find this? Have you shown it to the police?” Chen Ge returned the photograph to the table and wiped his damp palms.

“The night before he disappeared, my brother watched a football match at a bar with friends. To make sure he reached work the next morning, he decided to sleep in the nurse’s office. On his way there, he passed a classroom filled with people. He stopped at the door and praised the students for studying so late. They seemed to be taking a class photograph, and when they noticed him, they invited him to sit in the middle. Afterward, the students left. He never knew who gave him the finished picture.” The woman’s voice remained flat, but the story made Chen Ge’s skin crawl.

“The photograph shocked my brother sober. Only then did he realize he was sitting inside the sealed classroom.” She pushed the picture toward Chen Ge. “He told only my sister-in-law and me. We thought the whole thing would pass, but the next day Xiao Yu disappeared. They went searching for him and vanished themselves. That’s why I believe the sealed classroom took them. It wasn’t revenge.”

“What did the police say?” Chen Ge pushed the photo back.

“They took the photograph to Mu Yang High School and investigated. Although the students wore the school uniform, none matched anyone enrolled there. The police opened the sealed classroom and searched it. They found only my brother’s footprints, confirming that he had indeed entered the room.”

“All right, I understand.” Chen Ge asked several more questions, but the woman either did not know the answers or responded vaguely. Once it became clear she had nothing more to offer, he stood to leave.

“Leaving so soon? It’s so hot outside, why don’t you take a sip of the drink before you leave?”

“Thank you, but I’m not thirsty.” Chen Ge thanked the woman for her kindness before leaving the second floor.

After the conversation with the woman, Chen Ge had a better understanding of Mu Yang High School. There are four side missions at Mu Yang High School, and two of them are related to the little boy’s family.

He took Fan Yu’s drawing from his pocket and studied it again. The contrast between black and red seemed to carry a message. A black house and red people. Is this connected to Mu Yang High School? Does the drawing depict one of its buildings?
